scope: 1959 Seoul National University Graduate School of Public Administration founding-date semantics, institutional placement, first-cohort and research-office implementation

findings.claim: SNU GSPA's current official history describes the school as established in January 1959 by presidential decree inside the College of Law, then separated from the College of Law in March 1961.
findings.provenance: SNU GSPA official history and official brochure
findings.implication: The 1959 event should not be modeled as an already independent graduate-school bureaucracy; legal creation, host-unit placement and later administrative separation are distinct sub-events.

findings.claim: The same official history records the first 80 MPA graduates in March 1961.
findings.implication: The first-cohort graph can be anchored to a bounded population and a fixed graduation month rather than anecdotal alumni references alone.

findings.claim: SNU Korea Institute of Public Affairs states that its predecessor 조사연구실 began when GSPA was created on 1959-01-13 and was later renamed 행정조사연구소 under SNU Rule No. 95 on 1967-11-06.
findings.provenance: SNU Korea Institute of Public Affairs official history; KCI institutional registry independently converges on a 1959 조사연구실 start
findings.implication: The research-office layer is a distinct institutional sub-event attached to the founding network; exact first director, staffing, budget and internal order remain open.

findings.claim: SNU's 2014 official GSPA brochure explicitly cites the Education Act and Seoul National University Establishment Decree and gives 1959-01-13 as the establishment date.
findings.implication: 1959-01-13 is an institutional founding convention supported by SNU; it must be kept semantically separate from the previously recovered 1959-04-01 general effective date of Presidential Decree No. 1429.

findings.claim: Korea University's official profile of Paik Wan-ki independently records SNU undergraduate graduation in 1959 and SNU GSPA MPA completion in 1961.
findings.provenance: Korea University Institute for Government Studies official faculty profile
findings.implication: Paik is a strong first-cohort anchor but not proof of the complete roster.

findings.claim: SNU Archives biographical holdings show that a later GSPA dean served as Ministry of Education Higher Education Bureau director in 1960 and GSPA dean from 1962 to 1965.
findings.implication: The Ministry-SNU personnel bridge should be mined systematically; however this later career does not establish who routed the 1958-1959 proposal.

adversarial_checks: Do not collapse 1959-01-13 institutional founding convention into the decree's 1959-04-01 general effective date.
Do not infer that 조사연구실 existed as a legally separate research institute in January 1959 merely because later institutional histories date its origin there.
Do not infer the first GSPA dean from later deans or prominent founding professors.
Do not infer that all 80 first graduates entered on one identical date without the 1959 admission register.
Do not infer presidential policy origination from presidential-decree promulgation.
Do not infer Ministry proposal authorship from ministerial jurisdiction alone.
Do not treat a retrospective institutional founding date as equivalent to the first day of teaching.
Do not promote academic actors to politician registry without material public-office evidence.
Do not treat the 1961 administrative separation from Law College as a new legal founding of GSPA.
Do not resolve the 1958 No Yung-hee chronology anomaly without SNU personnel records.

status_note: No Floot modification or build. No politician-registry promotion in this pass because the newly strengthened nodes are primarily academic/institutional and the public-office threshold was not yet met.
